adsetTakeaway: For 20–26 October, Video/Reels delivered 8 of 10 Meta-reported leads and 4 of 5 reported registrations; Static delivered 2 leads and 1 registration. Keep both in the mix while checking actual signup quality.
creativeNote: The refreshed ads went live around 19–20 October. Across the campaign to 26 October, the Refunding Users repost recorded 4 leads on NZ$407.37 spend, while the IRD Letter static recorded 2 leads on NZ$125.54. These are cumulative ad figures, not just this week's results. Judge the next creative round on registrations and eventual activations, not clicks alone.

findings.title: New creative is live
findings.body: The refreshed Video/Reels and Static ads launched around 19–20 October. Through 26 October, the Refunding Users repost recorded 4 leads on NZ$407.37 spend; the IRD Letter static recorded 2 leads on NZ$125.54. These are cumulative ad figures. Several other new variants still have little evidence.

findings.title: Traffic rose faster than leads
findings.body: Compared with 13–19 October, 20–26 October generated 868 landing-page views versus 338, while reported leads moved from 9 to 10. Spend rose from NZ$820.40 to NZ$949.26. Meta-reported registrations held at 5 in each week. More traffic has not yet yielded a proportionate rise in leads.

findings.title: Video/Reels led this week
findings.body: Video/Reels delivered 8 leads and 4 Meta-reported registrations on NZ$708.81 during 20–26 October; Static delivered 2 leads and 1 registration on NZ$240.45. These tracked actions are not verified paying customers, so check signup quality before shifting budget.

nextSteps.title: Check where the extra traffic drops off
nextSteps.body: Review the live ad links and mobile sign-up journey, then compare landing-page views, Lead events and Lodg registrations by date. Traffic rose sharply in 20–26 October, but Lead events barely moved.

nextSteps.title: Review the new ads against registrations
nextSteps.body: Compare each new ad's leads and registrations after another full week, and keep the proven $47+gst static ad and Refunding Users creative in the mix while assessing signup quality. Do not scale the repost solely because its clicks are cheap.

nextSteps.title: Match reported results to paying customers
nextSteps.body: Reconcile Meta Lead and Complete Registration events against Lodg's registrations and first payouts. Use cost per activated customer, not just cost per Lead, to decide which ads and ad sets deserve more spend.

nextSteps.title: Hold the roughly NZ$4,000 monthly pace for now
nextSteps.body: The last reported allocation was NZ$100/day Video/Reels and NZ$33/day Static (NZ$133/day, roughly NZ$3,990 per 30 days). Confirm the live budgets in Ads Manager before changing them. Reallocate within that total only after checking lead quality and registrations; discuss any increase with Lodg after activation costs are known.
